course_name_original: Aspectos Genéricos y Específicos de la Investigación Científica
course_name_en: Generic and Specific Aspects of Scientific Research

learning_outcomes.text: Be original in the development and application of ideas, within a research environment.
Solution of problem in new and unfamiliar multidisciplinary environments, related to its knowledge area.
Integration of knowledge, facing the complexity of issuing judgments and sentences parting from some information that includes ethic and social liability constraints.
Ability of communicating justified decisions and conclusions, to specialized and unspecialized listeners.
Critical analysis of the information coming from sensing and instrumentation subsystems.
Asses the risks of the use of electrical energy, as well as those of industrial installations, understanding the necessity of safety elements, protections and signalling in power systems.
Practical and experimental verification of monitoring and controlling electrical energy conversion systems, including safety operation of electric systems
Skills related to teamwork, recognizing different roles within a group and different ways of organizing research teams.
Ability to manage information: search, analysis and synthesis of the specific technical information.
Ability to assimilate and communicate information in English concerning technical
Ability to plan and organize work
Skills for critical reasoning, making decisions and making judgments based on information that include reflecting on social and ethical responsibilities of professional activity
Concern for quality and achievement motivation
To develop the methodology of scientific research in engineering according to the ethical implications throughout the research process.
Knowledge of resources for information search and management: databases, subject gateways and sources of funding.
To develop a scientific paper using the methods of analysis, synthesis and presentation of technical writing themselves.
Using different software tools for conducting research work.
To evaluate the different options when publishing the results of an investigation.

syllabus_topics: Introduction - Differences between hard sciences and Research in Engineering
Engineering Research - How to carry a literature review: information data bases, engineering portals, journals
Engineering Research - Writing Research reports/papers - Structure of the report/paper
Engineering Research - Writing Research reports/papers - Software tools for writing reports/papers
Engineering Research - Writing Research reports/papers - References and citing
Engineering Research - Preparing and delivering a presentation: communication skills
Dissemination of research - Publication - Publish or perish
Dissemination of research - Publication - How to publish: choosing the" right" journal
Dissemination of research - How to reach the non-scientific community: i.e. industry
Research Funding opportunities - Public funding sources: EU, national, regional
Research Funding opportunities - How to write a research Project
Research ethics - Is it necessary? Examples

assessment_methods.method: Attendance to lectures and active participation

assessment_rules: A minimum score of 4/10 is needed on both the written exam and the assignment (report + presentation) to pass the subject. For students unable to attend lectures regularly, the 10% for attendance and participation will not apply. Homeworks and exams will be the same as for regular evaluation, with flexible deadlines and exam dates.
